summary: Israeli forces conducted targeted strikes in Gaza eliminating two operatives funneling Iranian and Turkish funds to Hamas while destroying weapon depots. Iraqi officials attribute airstrikes on Iranian-supplied Chinese air defense systems in Baghdad to Israel. Simultaneously, Israeli artillery and airstrikes hit multiple locations in southern Lebanon as Iranian air defenses engage drones over Bandar Abbas.
key_points: IDF killed Hamas cell commander Alaa Arshi in Gaza City and PIJ operative Karam Abu Butaihan in Nuseirat, both transferring millions from Iran and Turkey to Hamas military wing. (Source: @manniefabian/59421)
Israeli airstrikes destroyed three Hamas weapon depots in central Gaza containing Kalashnikov rifles, rockets, and a rocket launcher. (Source: @manniefabian/59421)

Iraqi officials suspect Israeli airstrikes hit two warehouses storing Chinese-made air defense systems recently transferred from Iran to Tehran-backed militias near Baghdad. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8855)

Israeli warplanes struck Kfar Tibnit in southern Lebanon while artillery hit Aita al-Jabal, Zibqin, Beit Yahoun, Wadi al-Saluqi, and Majdal Zoun. (Source: @yediotnews25/136738, @redlinkleb/49756, @redlinkleb/49760)

Iranian Army announced downing a drone over Bandar Abbas, Hormozgan Province, with additional explosion reported in Ahvaz and power outage on Kish Island. (Source: @shin_persian/11481, @shin_persian/11488, @shin_persian/11474)
Israeli Navy conducted joint drill with Hellenic Navy in Mediterranean practicing sinking enemy vessels, signaling strategic cooperation against Turkey. (Source: @manniefabian/59419)
Israeli GLF5 SIGINT aircraft (Nachshon Eitam) conducted electronic surveillance over Palestine at 39,100 ft and 37,025 ft. (Source: @redlinkleb/49841, @redlinkleb/49826)
IDF imposed West Bank lockdown for Israeli elections, barring 9,000 Palestinian workers from settlements and closing all crossings on election day. (Source: @manniefabian/59420)

points: Iranian Army announced downing a "Lucas" drone over Bandar Abbas in Hormozgan Province, indicating active air defense engagement along southern coast. (Source: @shin_persian/11481)
Explosion sound reported in Ahvaz near Chaharshir neighborhood in Khuzestan Province, cause unconfirmed but occurring amid heightened regional tension. (Source: @shin_persian/11488)
Power outage affected Kish Island in Hormozgan Province, potentially linked to infrastructure strain or security measures. (Source: @shin_persian/11474)
Iranian Army Air Force fighter jet observed over Baharestan in Isfahan Province, suggesting increased air patrol activity. (Source: @shin_persian/11486)
Blasts in Dezful attributed to unexploded ordnance (UXO) rather than fresh attacks, per Iranian sources. (Source: @shin_persian/11480)
Heavy security deployment including anti-riot forces near Khomeini's shrine in southern Tehran, indicating internal security concerns. (Source: @shin_persian/11492)

Israeli GLF5 SIGINT aircraft (Nachshon Eitam) conducted electronic surveillance over Palestine at 39,100 ft (call sign IRON) and 37,025 ft (call sign ROEM). (Source: @redlinkleb/49841, @redlinkleb/49826)

sections.threat_assessment: Israel is conducting simultaneous kinetic operations across Gaza, Lebanon, and Iraq targeting Iranian supply chains and proxy capabilities. The elimination of Hamas finance operatives and destruction of weapon depots in Gaza degrades immediate reconstitution efforts, while strikes on Iranian air defense transfers in Iraq disrupt militia deterrence. Lebanese front shows sustained artillery and airstrike pressure on Hezbollah positions. Iranian internal security alerts and air defense engagements suggest heightened threat perception. Multi-front coordination indicates Israeli strategy of preemptive degradation ahead of potential escalation.
sections.regional_response: Greece deepens naval cooperation with Israel through joint exercises explicitly messaging Turkey, signaling shifting Mediterranean alignments. Saudi Arabia maintains civil defense alerts in southern regions bordering Yemen. Iraq's official attribution of strikes to Israel marks rare public acknowledgment of Israeli operations on Iraqi soil. Iranian domestic security deployments near key regime sites reflect concern over internal stability amid external pressure. Palestinian movement restrictions in West Bank during Israeli elections highlight governance friction.
sections.intelligence_notes: Israeli SIGINT flights over Palestine at high altitude indicate persistent electronic surveillance of Gaza and West Bank communications. The specific targeting of Chinese-made air defense systems in Iraq suggests intelligence on Iranian weapons transfer routes and militia depot locations. Hamas finance network disruption reveals Israeli penetration of Iran-Turkey funding channels. Lebanese strike pattern shows methodical targeting of border villages used by Hezbollah. Iranian drone downing over Bandar Abbas may indicate Israeli or US reconnaissance probing southern air defenses.
